suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add guidance for workers to verify commits are actually made before reporting success. Workers should run git status after git commit to confirm changes are committed.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit step after 'Commit changes' to verify commit was successful: 'Run git status to confirm no uncommitted changes remain for the file(s) modified.'
